With the issuance of the bonus shares, the paid-up capital of the bank now stands at Rs. 1.479 billion, it said in a statement. As of the end of the last fiscal year, the bank has mobilized Rs. 11.1 billion in deposits and disbursed Rs. 8.96 billion in loans. The bank made a profit of Rs. 85 million in the last fiscal year, the state- ment added. ल्ष्लतज न्यिदबि दचबलअज KATHMANDU: Global Bank on Wednesday opened its ninth branch at Gyaneswor. The two-year-old bank already has branches at Kantipath, New Road, and Bouddha in Kathmandu, two branches in Pokhara and one each in Birgunj, Lahan and Biratnagar. The bank has plans to open four more branches in the coming months, according to its press release. It also offers evening banking and 365-day banking among its services. त्चष्पयल नषत KATHMANDU: Advertising agency Trikon Advertising has given a gift of Rs. 11,100 to economic journalist Gajendra Budhathoki who was injured in a motorcycle accident last year. Managing director of Trikon Advertising Rajendra Aryal presented a cheque to Budhathoki at the latter's residence on Wednesday, according to a statement issued by the agency.
